bloques.titulo: The logical validation of a conclusion
texto: In the drafting of expert reports and academic essays it is not enough to have juxtaposed facts; it is essential to verify whether the deduction (**Schlussfolgerung**) is necessarily derived from the premises (**Prämissen**) formulated: **Aus den vorliegenden Daten lässt sich keineswegs ableiten, dass die Strategie gescheitert sei** (From the data available in no way can it be inferred that the strategy has failed).

bloques.titulo: Lexic resources to weigh the conclusive validity
texto: To question hasty conclusions epistemic distance turns are used: **voreilige Schlüsse ziehen** (draw hasty conclusions), **auf lückenhaften Annahmen beruhen** (based on incomplete assumptions) and **den Kausalzusammenhang belegen** (demonstrate the causal relationship - effect).

filas: Dieser Befund lässt sich klar ableiten.
